desc: Verify the lemma: for odd prime p, ord_{p^{e+1}}(1+p) = p^e; for p=2 use ord_{2^{e+2}}(5) = 2^e (e≥1).
Design the per-prime-power component: given p^e ∥ N, produce (a_i, m_i) with ord_{m_i}(a_i) = p^e and all m_i pairwise coprime across components.
Implement CRT to combine components into single (A, M) with A, M ≤ 1e18; check the product of moduli stays within 1e18 for N ≤ 1e9 (worst-case bound analysis).
Handle special cases: N=1 (output any A with M=1, e.g., "1 1" — sample confirms M=1 allowed).
Implement fast factorization: sieve primes up to 31623 once, trial-divide each N; T ≤ 1e4 so this is fast enough.
Write final Python solution with fast I/O, verify construction against brute-force order checks for small N, and confirm edge cases (N=1, N=16, N=55, prime N near 1e9).
